description: Use this to see the user's saved Sidekick actions and the built-in ones: what each does and the params it takes. Call it before run_action when you need an action's params, when the user asks what actions there are, or when a task looks like one a saved action might already do. It reads the actions folder fresh, so it includes actions saved since this conversation began, from any assistant. set_configuration sets the user's own actions folder (actionsDir) and shared folders (sharedActionsDirs). If set_configuration has no such settings, the user's Sidekick is older than actions: ask the user to update Sidekick (https://sidekick.eastpole.nl/install) and the Sidekick UXP plugin in InDesign from Adobe Exchange, which also brings the Sidekick Actions panel.
name: list_actions
